title: Inspect final rich exports and native UI artifacts
description: Follow team/PLAN.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules and applicable child plan; preserve current dirty work. This board records unfinished acceptance/repair, not permission to rebuild existing features. Inspect current implementation and earlier evidence first; fix only reproduced gaps in owned files, record exact commands/results and fail-first controls, and report CLAIMED. No installs, new packages, commits, pushes, publication, real-library access or destructive cleanup. Before expensive checks, acquire exclusive registered path node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot via team.py files add; if another live task owns it, do independent work or hand off rather than overlap runs. Retain full logs and use pinned Node/offline serial Rust/production-preview Playwright. Independent review is required. Generate current synthetic DOCX/PDF/Markdown/archive outputs with images/tables/notes/citations and compare text/reference/hash sets. Inspect every rendered representative/adversarial page for clipping/overlap/glyph loss/notes and actual light/dark native UI screenshots. Use installed tools only. Inspect required accessibility/IME coverage where automated tools permit; list Word/ARM/interactive VoiceOver/IME/long-session checks as owner-pending when unavailable. Preserve PDF header-repeat/Jr-suffix/latency limitations unless actual current evidence closes them. No real writing or real Zotero data. Write the task report to docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-team-reconciliation/artifact-acceptance.md.
